title: Karen Silkwood and the missing plutonium

tellings.quote: that she discovered that they were missing 40 lbs of uh 98% bomb G plutonium from this facility

plain: In 1974, according to Dan Sheehan, a worker at a nuclear fuel plant in Oklahoma named Karen Silkwood discovered that 40 pounds of 98 percent bomb-grade plutonium was missing from the facility. Sheehan tells it as someone who was involved in the matter himself, and he ties it to a CIA officer named Theodore Shackley and a reporter named David Burnham. If true, it would mean that enough material for nuclear weapons had quietly gone missing.
